activities.title: 2027 season (The Comedy of Errors, Hay Fever, Next to Normal, Julius Caesar, Red, Mary’s Wedding)
activities.notes: A more detailed breakdown with the roles that may be available will be posted in October

prep.acting:
Please record two season-appropriate pieces, at least one of them Shakespeare (yes, both can be Shakespeare) under three minutes total. (Shorter is better, this is plenty of time.)
A slate is welcome but not necessary.
Please begin with your Shakespeare piece.
If you would like to include some singing, please end with it.
Please upload as a single video to YouTube (just Youtube).
bring: Please email auditions@santacruzshakespeare.org with your audition link, please attach an updated headshot and resume,
